settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Everything about orders, shipping and returns. Can't find it? Email support@vitalray.shop.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. Checkout is encrypted and secure.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Yes, as long as it hasn't shipped yet. Email support@vitalray.shop with your order number as soon as possible.

settings.question: Do you have a discount for first orders?
settings.answer: Sign up to our email list and you'll get 10% off your first order.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer: We ship to the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Australia.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are processed in 1–3 business days. Delivery usually takes 7–15 business days after shipping. Some items ship from different warehouses, so a multi-item order may arrive in separate packages.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is free on orders over $49. Rates for smaller orders are shown at checkout.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships. You can also use our Track Order page.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You can request a return within 30 days of delivery. Email us first and we'll send instructions. See our Refund Policy for details.

settings.question: My item arrived damaged or wrong — what now?
settings.answer: Email support@vitalray.shop within 30 days of delivery with your order number and a photo. We'll send a replacement or a full refund.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Approved refunds go back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.
